STEP 1 - Scene: roast potatoes, shredded green vegetable (cabbage/kale-style greens), and fried or breaded fish/chicken pieces; a cooked dinner plate.

STEP 2 - Vessel: white dinner plate ~26 cm diameter
Area = 3.14 x (13)^2 = 531 cm^2

STEP 3 - Items:
- roast potatoes (cubes)
- shredded cooked greens
- breaded/fried fish or chicken fillet pieces
- herbs/garnish (minor)

STEP 4 - Area:
- roast potatoes: 22% = 117 cm^2
- cooked greens: 20% = 106 cm^2
- fried fillet pieces: 15% = 80 cm^2
- herbs/garnish: 2% = 11 cm^2
- total food coverage: 59% of plate

STEP 5 - Volume:
- roast potatoes: 117 cm^2 x 2.5 cm = 293 ml
- cooked greens: 106 cm^2 x 2.0 cm = 212 ml
- fillet pieces: 80 cm^2 x 1.5 cm = 120 ml
- herbs/garnish: 11 cm^2 x 0.5 cm = 6 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- roast potatoes: 293 ml x 0.6 = 176 g
- cooked greens: 212 ml x 0.15 = 32 g
- fillet pieces: 120 ml x 0.95 = 114 g
- herbs/garnish: 6 ml x 0.15 = 1 g
- total: 323 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- roast potatoes: 176 g x 130 kcal/100g = 229 kcal (roasted in oil, ~150 kcal/100g used: 264 kcal)
- cooked greens: 32 g x 35 kcal/100g = 11 kcal (with butter/oil estimate, ~40 kcal/100g: 13 kcal)
- fillet pieces: 114 g x 200 kcal/100g = 228 kcal
- herbs/garnish: 1 g x 40 kcal/100g = 0 kcal
- total: 264 + 13 + 228 = 505 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: 323 g of potatoes, greens and fried fish on a 59%-covered dinner plate is plausible.
